import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def verify(req, ev, pol, exp):
    before=copy.deepcopy((req,ev,pol))
    got=evaluate(req,ev,pol)
    assert got==exp,(got,exp)
    assert (req,ev,pol)==before
    assert list(got)==['status','value','sources','unknowns']

p={'required_conditions':['z','a'],'require_verified':True}
verify({'claim':'x','conditions':{}},[],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','z']})
r={'claim':'x','conditions':{'z':2,'a':1}}
e=[{'source':'old','claim':'x','value':4,'conditions':{'z':2,'a':1},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'x','value':5,'conditions':{'z':2,'a':1},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']},{'source':'wrong','claim':'x','value':9,'conditions':{'z':3,'a':1},'verified':True,'supersedes':['new']}]
verify(r,e,p,{'status':'supported','value':5,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
verify(r,[{'source':'f','claim':'x','value':False,'conditions':{'z':2,'a':1},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['f'],'unknowns':[]})
verify(r,[{'source':'f','claim':'x','value':False,'conditions':{'z':2,'a':1},'verified':True},{'source':'n','claim':'x','value':0,'conditions':{'z':2,'a':1},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['f','n'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); evidence=json.load(open('evidence.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json'))
actual=[evaluate(q,evidence,policy) for q in requests]
assert actual==json.load(open('report.json'))
schema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json'))
for item in actual:
    assert set(item)==set(schema['required'])
    assert item['status'] in schema['properties']['status']['enum']
    assert all(isinstance(x,str) for x in item['sources']+item['unknowns'])
print(json.dumps(actual,sort_keys=True))
